metadataRaw.title: How to Fix a Pinched Nerve in Lower Back & Leg (INSTANT RELIEF)
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates easy exercises that can provide fast relief from sharp, shooting pain caused by a pinched nerve in the lower back and leg. 

These exercises are especially helpful for sciatica and are designed to reduce tension and pressure along the entire sciatic nerve pathway.

They target common causes of nerve irritation, including bulging or herniated discs and tight muscles that may compress or irritate the sciatic nerve.

For the best results, try all of the exercises and focus on the ones that provide you with the greatest relief.

Watch now and start relieving lower back, leg, and sciatic nerve pain today!
